title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: A Central Sector scheme to supplement financial needs of landholding farmers' families in procuring various inputs related to agriculture and domestic needs.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹6,000 per year released in three equal 4-monthly installments of ₹2,000 directly into the bank accounts of beneficiaries.
eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable landholding in their names are eligible.
Subject to certain exclusion criteria related to higher economic status.
exclusions: Farmer families in which one or more members are former or present holders of constitutional posts, ministers, MPs, MLAs.
All serving or retired officers and employees of central/state government.
All persons who paid Income Tax in last assessment year.

steps: Visit the official portal at pmkisan.gov.in
Navigate to 'Farmers Corner' and select 'New Farmer Registration'
Enter Aadhaar Number and select your State
Fill required personal and land holding details (Khatauni/Khasra)
Submit and save the registration acknowledgment number

documentsRequired: Land Ownership Record (Khatauni / Record of Rights)
Bank Account Passbook with IFSC code
Active Mobile Number linked to Aadhaar

faqs.question: What is the benefit under PM-KISAN?
faqs.answer: Eligible farmers receive ₹6,000 annually in three equal installments of ₹2,000.

faqs.question: Is Aadhaar mandatory for PM-KISAN?
faqs.answer: Yes, Aadhaar authentication is mandatory for receiving benefits under PM-KISAN.

title: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: Flagship national health insurance scheme providing secondary and tertiary care hospitalization coverage.
benefits: Cashless health insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year.
Covers up to 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses.
No restriction on family size, age, or gender.
eligibility: Households identified as deprived rural families or specific occupational urban worker categories as per SECC 2011.
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above regardless of income.
exclusions: Government employees or families paying income tax.

steps: Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in using mobile number or Ration Card
Visit any empanelled public or private hospital or CSC center with Aadhaar card
Receive and download the Ayushman Card

faqs.question: Can I receive treatment in any state?
faqs.answer: Yes, benefits are portable across all empanelled hospitals throughout India.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: Small deposit savings scheme for a girl child launched under the Beti Bachao Beti Padhao campaign to meet education and marriage expenses.
benefits: Attractive government-notified interest rate compounded annually.
Tax deduction under Section 80C of Income Tax Act up to ₹1.5 Lakh per year.
Interest earned and maturity amount are completely exempt from tax.
eligibility: Can be opened by natural or legal guardian in the name of a girl child from birth until she attains the age of 10 years.
A maximum of two accounts allowed per family (one for each girl child, with exceptions for triplets/twins).
exclusions: Girls who have crossed 10 years of age.
More than two accounts in a single household unless multiple girls are born in first/second order of birth.

steps: Visit any designated Post Office or authorized commercial bank branch
Attach girl child birth certificate and guardian KYC documents

documentsRequired: Birth Certificate of the girl child
Identity Proof of the Parent / Guardian (Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID)
Passport-sized photographs of guardian and child

faqs.question: What is the minimum annual deposit?
faqs.answer: The minimum deposit is ₹250 per financial year, with a maximum of ₹1,50,000.
